layers.note: Layers inside a package need every file: run `scripts/graph/` in a checkout for layers and what triggers what

fixes.text: Run only what a change can reach: no path filters or affected-only selection on PR workflows
1 test file takes over 10 s; the slowest, github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql, takes 212 s
Jobs wait 294 s for a runner at p90: GitHub-hosted runners are often slow to start, so price a faster provider
Cancel superseded PR runs: no concurrency with cancel-in-progress
Move broad checks to a scheduled sweep

notes.text: No AGENTS.md: agents working here have no instructions, such as how to run one test
ci-doctor's guides are strongest for TypeScript and Rust. For Go it applies the principles, without a Go-specific page
